label: sec:beta-decay-mechanism-hadron-half-life-preamble
html: This section assembles the substrate-level \beta-decay mechanism and the resulting hadron half-life predictions. We move from the hadron half-life verification data to the half-life regimes. We perform the leading-order derivation, which is pinned by the N-V Bring action and the tower-depth-90 expansion. We tabulate a per-shell half-life worked example, use the half-life as a q-probe, and interpret the finiteness bound. Finally, we specialise to tritium decay.
